name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, static content, certificates, security hardening, Fail2ban, firewall rules, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log-directory management, and Redis configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, application dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
